title: Let a session started after legacy history adoption write events while the adopted legacy log stays guarded
description: Let a session started after legacy history adoption write events while the adopted legacy log stays guarded
no_spec_change_rationale: Bug fix within REQ-history-006 and the history adoption requirement: a new session must write events, and unexpected legacy changes still refuse writes; no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: In a project that adopted a legacy transition log, a session started with chough session new writes events to its own cycle; the legacy log keeps its bytes, stays out of the new session's history, and a change to it still refuses writes in every session. The new test fails first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Found while adopting sessions on this repository (DRIVE-12), which Leif chose (Adopt + new criterion, 2026-11-05).
